ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2002

FRONTIER PROVINCE HIGHWAYS AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Highways Authority Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 24th September, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(15)/71/7076, dated
24-9-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--- (1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West, Frontier
Province Highways Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Highways Authority Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Substitution of section 21 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIX of 2001

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE HIGHWAYS AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Highways Authority Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 24th September, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(15)/71/7076, dated
24-9-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
7. Substitution of section 21 of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIX of
2001.---In the said Ordinance, for section 21, the following shall be
substituted namely;
"21. Funds
and budget of the Authority.--- (1) There shall be two separate
non-lapsable funds to be known as Frontier Highways Authority Development
Fund" and "Frontier Highways Authority Road Maintenance Fund",
vesting in the Authority and shall be utilized by it to meet the expenses in
connection with its functions under this Ordinance including the remuneration
payable to its employees.
(2) The amounts at the credit of
each of the Funds shall be inter transferable with the approval of the Council.
(3) The Frontier Highways
Authority Development Fund and the Frontier Highways Authority Road Maintenance
Fund shall be separately kept in a Schedule Bank and shall be operated
according to, the rules and regulations of the Authority.
(4) The Frontier Highways
Authority Development Fund shall have to its credit all the moneys received by
the Authority on any of the following accounts:
(a) loans
obtained from Government, including tic Federal Government:
(b) any other
loan obtained by the Authority, if so permitted by Government:
(c) grants made
or funds provided by Government, an the Federal Government for development:
(d) foreign
aids, grants and loans negotiated and raised by the Authority with the approval
of Government;
(e) all other
sums received by the Authority, such as fees, damages, costs, refunds
forfeiture, sale proceeds lease moneys, rentals and fines:
(f) income from
sale of assets, lands and vehicles belonging to the Authority and
(g) funds from
floating bonds, shares or through any other means, if so permitted by
Government.
(5) The following Provincial
receipts, which heretofore formed part of the Provincial Consolidated Fund,
shall be credited to the Frontier Highways Authority Road Maintenance Fund for
utilization on maintenance of provincial Roads and Highways:
(a) renewal of
fee of contractors registration;
(b) grants, of
maintenance of roads if any;
(c) sale of
tender forms:
(d) initial fee
recoverable from CNG/Petrol Pumps on Provincial Highways; .
(e) income from
lease of approaches to service station/CNG/Petrol Pumps on Provincial Highways;
(f) toll tax on
Provincial Highways: and
(g)
proportionate share in the sugarcane cess allocated/collected corresponding to
use of Provincial Highways in a certain zone.
(6) The budget of the Authority
shall be formulated in three separate parts, firstly Construction/Development
Budget, secondly Operational: Budget' and thirdly Repairs and Maintenance
Budget'; provided that any re -appropriation amongst the aforesaid three heads
of budgets shall require recommendation of the Council and approval of
Provincial Cabinet in the Revised Budget Estimates".
